comments: Input facts: ego is the car initiator; agent1 is the pedestrian responder; the group permits stationary non-crossing trafficway occupancy. Chosen assumptions: ego initially holds still for 1 s, then initiates the conflict by applying throttle 0.18-0.24 toward agent1 standing near the lane center 18-21 m ahead. Ego brakes at 10-12 m with input 0.7-0.9; agent1 stays still. This is a launch into an occupied forward path rather than a moving approach. Outcome intent: conflict opportunity, with no collision requirement. All realizations use stationary pedestrians because the schema provides no parallel-walking pedestrian maneuver.
